e2aBehaviour.summary: The SQL function customer.saved_mission_book builds a TRIP or SUPPLIER projection key by key from the saved report the signed-in customer can already read, through the same ownership, revocation, expiry and retention gates. The PDF is rendered on the fly inside the database transaction before commit and is never stored (D05 object storage stays closed), so a book that cannot be made leaves no record or event. The generation record is one row in the existing immutable saved_mission_command ledger (kind, resource, publication, schema version, generatedAt, SHA-256 of the projection, no content) plus one delivery.book.generated event whose payload carries no saved-mission id.
e2aBehaviour.retriesAndLimits: The same command id returns the same record with no second record or event; a changed source makes the retry fail with 23514 (409); 30 new generations per hour per customer and mission, then 429.
e2aBehaviour.route: POST only, with origin, body, rate and header controls and a uniform 403 for every denial; answers 503 while CORRIDRA_UX_BOOKS is off, the module is not installed or the service is unavailable; X-Corridra-Book-Digest, X-Corridra-Book-Replayed and X-Corridra-Book-Generated-At response headers.
e2aBehaviour.unchanged: CLIENT_PROGRESS.allow_export is untouched and stays false. reportPdf is byte-identical to main (86460 bytes on a rich fixture and 85288 on a 40-mission fixture): builder-reported, no receipt file records the byte counts; the delivery.test.ts and product-experience.test.ts regression passes (pdf-regress, 23 passed).
e2aBehaviour.installer: scripts/install-customer-modules.ts gains customer_book_migrations: the install report moves from 'not installed' to '1 applied' only after an owner-approved protected install run. Until then the route answers 503 even with the switch on. No such run has been dispatched.
e2aBehaviour.noPanel: No download panel, copy or browser test exists yet (E2b). CORRIDRA_UX_BOOKS is a real flag but nothing in the UI uses it.
decisionsRecorded: 'Owner/admin' in ADR-076 item 1 means the signed-in customer who owns the active saved mission, because a saved mission has no workspace role.
The Supplier Book carries the mission title as its heading.
No step-up MFA: customer routes use a fresh provider session and a verified email.
e2aBehaviour.reviews: Two independent reviews (SQL, authority and disclosure; PDF and route content) found no blocking defect (relayed by the conductor). Should-fix items fixed: record-versus-delivery rollback, test gaps, country names, 422 reasons, switch wording and event minimisation.
e2aBehaviour.mutationChecks: Reported by the builder and reviewer, no receipt files under work/: a widened allow-list failed 10 of 23 tests in an independent reviewer's copy; moving the render back out of the transaction, restoring the resource id in the event and removing the 422 reason each failed the intended tests.
